newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money stable at 9.0/10.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money stable at 9.0/10.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was stable at 9.0/10.0 percent on Thursday morning on the back of relatively sufficient rupiah liquidity, dealers said.
They said an early central bank injection of 644 billion rupiah seemed to help keep liquidity sufficient in the morning.
The central bank offered one-week SBIs at 11.25 percent, two-week at 11.50 percent, one-month at 12.50 percent, three-month at 13.25 percent, six-month at 13.50 percent and 12-month at 13.75 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Wednesday was 11.61 percent, compared with 12.21 percent on Tuesday.
